text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both posting modest gains, with Bitcoin holding firm at $82k and Ethereum trailing slightly at $2.4k, suggesting measured strength without explosive momentum. The Fear & Greed Index sits in greed territory at 59 but has retreated 10 points over the past week, indicating some cooling after recent optimism. Bitcoin's 59.7% dominance and robust $103B daily volume point to a market that remains engaged but cautious, with traders comfortable holding major positions rather than rotating aggressively into alts.
